name: Hope Charity
tagline: ME + YOU WE CAN SAVE A LIFE
description: Hope Charity is a community-focused charity working to bring hope, care and practical support to children and families in need.
about: We believe that when people come together, lives can change. Hope Charity supports children and communities through care, food support, practical help and opportunities for a better future.

programs.title: Children & Family Support
programs.text: Supporting vulnerable children and families with practical care and community assistance.

programs.title: Food & Basic Needs
programs.text: Helping provide meals and essential support to children and families who need it.

programs.title: Community Care
programs.text: Working with people in the community to identify needs and create lasting hope.
